There are two differnt commands that the controller sends to the phaser: a direction command a power command.

The responses from the phaser are different for the two commands.  

The display shows the results of both the commands.  When displaying the results of the direction command, it shoudl reuse the previous displayed value of the power command.  And vice versa, when displaying the results of the power command, it should reuse the previous displayed value of the direction command.
